I’ll join the agreement: I commit to catching 18 tons this month, with future quotas adjusted to the actual stock. That makes all five of us explicitly agreed.

If next month starts at 20 tons, I’ll support 3 tons each; if it starts at 10, I’ll support 1 each. We must leave at least 5 tons, and nobody should treat this month’s 18 as an automatic quota.

Let’s also revisit whether this approach actually improves our long-run earnings rather than judging it by this month’s larger payout. For now, my choice is 18 tons.
